cover_letter:
Dear Twipe Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my keen interest in the Frontend Developer position at Twipe, having been drawn to your innovative approach in supporting leading newspaper publishers. The opportunity to contribute to a mediatech scale-up dedicated to sustaining quality journalism, by building clean, seamless user interfaces for digital edition publishing and personalization solutions, truly excites me.

My foundational experience as a Front-End Developer at ViviDoctor involved optimizing front-end features for a healthcare web application using JavaScript and AngularJS. This built a strong base in web application development. Additionally, through my roles as a Web & SEO Specialist and Junior Digital Marketer, I have extensively utilized HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to design, build, and maintain client websites in WordPress, focusing on site structure, content presentation, and user experience. This includes developing and maintaining consistent layouts for large-scale sites, such as a pharmacists' association platform with hundreds of member profile pages.

I am adept at integrating various functionalities, having worked with AI agents and MCP integrations for WordPress and SEO tools, as well as ERP/POS and social media integrations in previous projects. This experience directly relates to leveraging third-party APIs to enhance application functionality. Furthermore, my hands-on experience in building and publishing an Android application live on Google Play demonstrates my aptitude for developing robust applications and deep platform engagement, skills I believe are highly transferable to React Native development.

While my explicit experience with React is limited, my strong background in JavaScript, object-oriented web application development, and mobile app creation provides a solid foundation. I have also completed coursework in Computer Science, reinforcing my technical understanding. I am a dedicated learner, enthusiastic about embracing new frameworks and contributing to a team that values innovation and impact.

Thank you for considering my application. I am confident that my technical skills, coupled with my passion for building intuitive web experiences, make me a valuable prospective addition to your team. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to Twipe's continued success.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
- Frontend development and optimization of a healthcare web application using AngularJS and JavaScript.
- Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for building and maintaining web applications and client websites.
- Experience designing and building multi-page websites in WordPress, focusing on UI, site structure, and consistent layouts.
- Aptitude for integrating third-party APIs, including AI agents, ERP/POS, and social media tools, to enhance functionality.
- Hands-on experience developing and publishing an Android application, demonstrating mobile app development and platform integration skills.
